rows.what: The existing net-edge gate is now armed at the decided 25 bp margin (qip_edge::cell::NET_EDGE_MARGIN_BP) in qip-edge-node's cell_configuration and the qip-cli demo cell, and a test drives a cell to the net_edge refusal at that margin (30 bp refused, 60 bp trades). No existing test or fixture was changed.
rows.remains: Slippage is not in the gate. Sweep-vs-touch slippage is always zero because the depth gate refuses any size above the touch; sweep-vs-mid is the half-spread, which refuses the existing 60 bp fixture (100 bp spread). Needs a person to say which reference price a rule's stated edge is against. Edgeless signals still pass (counted); no committed strategy declares an edge. The node arming is guarded by a source-text test, not a constructed NodeConfig. Not deployed.
rows.test_command: cargo test -p qip-edge --test feasibility && cargo test -p qip-edge-node --test net_edge_armed && cargo test -p qip-cli --lib the_demonstration_cell
